425.h: The University of Offa is a private university licensed by the National Universities Commission. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2021, when President Muhammadu Buhari approved it along with a group of other new private universities.
425.c: It is located in Offa, in Offa local government area of Kwara State.

426.h: Mewar International University Nigeria (MIU) is a private, co-educational university founded in 2021.
426.a: The university offers undergraduate programmes and is licensed by the National Universities Commission.
426.c: It is located at Masaka, near New Karu, in Nasarawa State, close to Abuja.

427.h: Anan University is a private university associated with the Association of National Accountants of Nigeria (ANAN). It builds on the Nigerian College of Accountancy, which was set up in 1994 in Barkin Ladi, Plateau State, to train certified national accountants. The National Universities Commission records the university's establishment in 2021.
427.a: Reflecting its origins, the university has a particular focus on accounting and related management disciplines.
427.c: It is located at Kwall, in Plateau State.

428.h: North Eastern University, Gombe is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2022.
428.c: It is located in Gombe, Gombe State, and offers hostel accommodation for students.

429.h: Al-Ansar University is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2022.
429.c: It is located in Maiduguri, Borno State.

430.h: Margaret Lawrence University is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2022.
430.c: It is located in Umunede, Delta State, with a residential campus.

431.h: Khalifa Isiyaku Rabiu University is a private university named after the Kano Islamic scholar Khalifa Isiyaku Rabiu. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2022.
431.c: It is located in Kano and has on-campus hostels, which are allocated through the student portal after an admission offer is accepted.

432.h: The Sports University, Idumuje-Ugboko, also called Sports University of Nigeria, was Nigeria's first university dedicated to sport. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2022.
432.a: The university combines academic degrees with sport, offering programmes in sports science, coaching, sports management and related fields.
432.c: It is located in Idumuje-Ugboko, Delta State.

433.h: Baba-Ahmed University, Kano is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2022.
433.a: Admission is through JAMB's Unified Tertiary Matriculation Examination, and the university publishes lists of successful applicants on its official channels.

434.h: SAISA University of Medical Sciences and Technology is a private university and the first private university of medical sciences and technology in Sokoto State. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2022.
434.a: The university specialises in medical and health sciences and related technology.
434.c: It is located in Sokoto, Sokoto State.

435.h: Nigerian British University (NBU) is a private, co-educational university owned and run by the Adorable Foundation for Educational Development. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2022.
435.c: It is located in Asa, Abia State.

436.h: Peter University is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2022.
436.a: The university offers undergraduate programmes, supported by laboratories, ICT hubs and libraries.
436.c: It is located in Achina-Onneh, Anambra State.

437.h: Newgate University, Minna is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2022, and the university has since held its first convocation.
437.c: It is located in Minna, the capital of Niger State.

438.h: The European University of Nigeria (EUN) is a private university founded by Prince Nicholas Ukachukwu, a former member of the House of Representatives. It received its final approval from the National Universities Commission in 2022.
438.c: It is located at Duboyi, in the Federal Capital Territory.

439.h: NorthWest University, Sokoto (NWUS) is a private university approved in May 2022.
439.a: The university offers undergraduate programmes in the sciences and other fields.
439.c: It is located at Kalambaina Industrial Layout in Wamakko local government area, Sokoto State.

440.h: Rayhaan University, Birnin Kebbi is a private university founded by Abubakar Malami, a former Attorney General of the Federation and Minister of Justice. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2023.
440.c: It is located in Birnin Kebbi, the capital of Kebbi State.

441.h: Muhammad Kamalud University is a private university named after Sheikh Muhammad Kamalud, an Islamic scholar. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2023.
441.c: It is located in Ilorin, Kwara State.

442.h: Sam Maris University (SMU) is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2023.
442.c: Its main campus is in Supare-Akoko, Ondo State.

443.h: Aletheia University is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2023.
443.c: It is located in Ago-Iwoye, Ogun State.

444.h: Lux Mundi University is a private university founded by Professor Gabriel O. C. Okenwa, its pro-chancellor. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2023.
444.a: The university offers undergraduate programmes and has an arrangement with an affiliate university in the United States under which some students can complete their bachelor's degrees there.
444.c: It is located in Umuahia, Abia State.

445.h: Maduka University is a private university established in 2023. It received its licence from the National Universities Commission and began its first academic session in November 2023.
445.c: It is located at Ekwegbe, in Igbo-Etiti local government area of Enugu State, on the new Enugu-Nsukka road.

446.h: PeaceLand University is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2023.
446.c: It is located in Enugu State and provides on-campus accommodation for students.

447.h: Amadeus University is a private university, one of 37 new private universities licensed by the National Universities Commission in 2023. It offered scholarships to some members of its pioneer class.
447.c: It is located in the Amizi community of Ikwuano local government area, Abia State.

448.h: Vision University is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2023.
448.a: The university admits both UTME and direct-entry candidates and offers internships, research opportunities and careers support.
448.c: It is located in Ikogbo, Ogun State.

449.h: Azman University, Kano is a private university established in 2023 by the Azman Group, led by Abdulmunaf Yunusa Sarina, to widen access to higher education.
449.a: The university emphasises innovation, entrepreneurship and practical skills.

450.h: Huda University is a private university in north-western Nigeria. Its name means 'guidance' in Arabic. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2023.
450.c: It is located in Gusau, Zamfara State.

451.h: Franco-British International University (FBIU) is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2023.
451.a: The university offers undergraduate programmes, including peace and conflict studies, and has explored clinical training and research partnerships with the National Eye Centre in Kaduna.
451.c: It is located in Kaduna, Kaduna State.

452.h: The Canadian University of Nigeria is a private university. The National Universities Commission records its establishment in 2023.
452.c: It is located in Abuja, the Federal Capital Territory.
